correctness.rationale: The exact twelve-arc object is independently enumerated as 115 augmented faces (1,12,42,48,12), all 4096 arc masks checked, and the 114 nonempty faces admit an acyclic 53-pair discrete-Morse matching; all 276 nonempty Hasse incidences are tested. Remaining cells are one 0-cell, one 1-cell and six 2-cells, with every signed integral Morse incidence exactly zero. The resulting single-loop CW attaching maps from S1 are degree zero and hence null-homotopic, proving S1 wedge six S2 integrally. The H1 primitive cycle/cocycle and 24 signed Lefschetz traces prove the exact rational homology representation; a separate mod-two rank calculation gives (11,30,12). Proof and checker are embedded at package paths RESULT.md, CHECK.py, and CHECK_OUTPUT.json. Finite computation is exhaustive for precisely this object and is not claimed as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The three most relevant primary papers were inspected at the materially relevant full-text sections, and actual semantic searches checked the theta/K2,3 names, cycle-free chessboard aliases, bidirectional graph classification, equivariant characters and larger-parameter examples. The 2022 complete-bipartite theorem is for one-way arcs and only Euler characteristic. The cycle-free chessboard theorem on complete digraphs supplies notation and connectivity bounds, not this calculation; the bidirectional polygon theorem does not apply to a theta. Indexed bidirected K3,3 and K2,4 finite results do not imply the homotopy type of their K2,3 subcomplex, nor its symmetry character. No exact or broader implication was identified, with residual unindexed-work risk.

value.rationale: The bidirected K2,3 is the canonical smallest genuine three-branch theta graph, directly extending the studied bidirectional paths and cycles but containing nontrivial intersecting directed cycles. A full integral homotopy type with two surviving dimensions, plus its 24-element rational symmetry character, is finer and substantially less automatic than Euler characteristic or Betti counts. It supplies a motivated exact boundary object for understanding what happens between bidirected polygon results and larger bidirected complete bipartite examples (including torsion cases). The precise intrinsic invariants, object and computational proof are explicit. The value claim is limited to this self-contained classification, not to a general family theorem.
